fusions.name: Wrecker's Lantern
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3 tiles of you takes a hit that deals 12 damage and knocks it back 2.5 tiles, with a 40% chance to turn it on its neighbours for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Taken as Prize
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health: a shot that deals 22 damage, with a 50% chance to turn the target on its own side for 3 seconds if it lives.

fusions.name: False Colours
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds, and you move 10% faster while veiled. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Smuggler's Moon
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
